title: DGM – Integrated Facilities Management (IFM)
jobDescription: Purpose of the Role: Lead end-to-end Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) operations across multiple manufacturing plants/campuses, ensuring safe, compliant, efficient, and cost-effective facility operations while delivering a world-class workplace experience. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end IFM operations including Housekeeping, Canteen/Food Services, Transport, Utilities, Security, Horticulture/Garden Maintenance, Pest Control, Waste & Scrap Management, Office Administration, and Soft & Hard FM services. Drive operational excellence through strong governance, SOP implementation, audits, service level management, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure 100% compliance with all applicable statutory, legal, EHS, fire & life safety, labor, and facility compliance requirements. Manage utility operations including electrical, HVAC, DG, water, compressed air, STP/WTP, firefighting systems, and critical infrastructure to ensure maximum uptime. Lead annual budgeting, cost optimization, productivity improvements, energy conservation, and value engineering initiatives to achieve measurable cost savings. Oversee material management, inventory control, critical spares, procurement coordination, and vendor performance management. Build and lead high-performing teams, including in-house employees and outsourced partners, while driving capability development and a strong performance culture. Manage multiple plant/campus operations simultaneously with standardized governance and performance reporting. Build strong relationships with business leaders and key stakeholders, ensuring high customer satisfaction and timely resolution of escalations. Drive sustainability initiatives, workplace improvements, digitalization, and innovation across facility operations. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics). Postgraduate qualification (MBA/PGDM) will be an added advantage. 15–20 years of relevant experience in Integrated Facilities Management, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role managing large manufacturing plants or multi-site operations. Proven experience in handling large teams, service partners, and multi-location facility operations. Strong understanding of statutory compliance, facility regulations, EHS, labor laws, fire safety, and utility management. Demonstrated success in cost optimization, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership. Excellent communication, negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills. Preferred Competencies: Strategic thinking, operational excellence, stakeholder management, financial acumen, vendor governance, crisis management, change leadership, and continuous improvement mindset.

title: Engineer I, Embededd Software Test
jobDescription: Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer to join our team. As a Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our firmware used in UPS systems. Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and execute test strategies and plans to validate firmware functionality, performance, and adherence to specifications. Your expertise will contribute to identifying and resolving firmware-related issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our products throughout their lifecycle. Responsibilities: Collaborate with the firmware development team to define comprehensive test strategies that cover functional, performance, and reliability aspects of the firmware. Design and create detailed test plans, including test cases and test scripts, based on firmware requirements and specifications. Execute tests on target hardware platforms, ensuring the proper functioning and compatibility of firmware with the hardware. Develop and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts to optimize testing efficiency and enhance test coverage, with a focus on automated system firmware testing. Identify, investigate, and report firmware defects using issue tracking systems, such as JIRA, and proficiently manage the end-to-end defect lifecycle. Work closely with the development team to prioritize and resolve identified issues, providing timely feedback and updates to stakeholders. Analyse and debug firmware issues using appropriate debugging tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and software debugging tools. Analyse test results and provide meaningful feedback to the firmware development team, suggesting improvements and optimizations for enhanced firmware performance and stability. Create and maintain detailed documentation related to test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including firmware developers, hardware engineers, quality assurance teams, and product managers, to ensure a comprehensive verification and validation process. Continuously research and explore emerging testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of firmware verification and validation processes, particularly in the field of automated system firmware testing. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication, Embedded system, Electrical /Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 3 to 5 years of experience in embedded systems firmware testing and verification. Required Skills: Proven experience in firmware verification and validation in the embedded systems domain. Solid understanding of firmware development principles, including knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ for embedded systems. Proficiency in test methodologies, test case design, and test automation frameworks, with specific experience in automated system firmware testing. Familiarity with hardware testing tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers. Knowledge of software development tools, such as integrated development environments (IDEs) and version control systems. Knowledge of integrating data loggers, power analyzers, and other relevant test equipment to automate system testing for power electronics products. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python for test automation and analysis. Experience with LabVIEW for hardware-in-the-loop testing and automated test system development. Strong JIRA management skills, including the ability to create, manage, and track issues, defects, and project tasks efficiently. Let us learn about you! Apply today. title: L4-Product support Engineer
jobDescription: Company Overview Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide. We are seeking a highly skilled L4 Product Support Engineer to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field. Role Overview The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers. You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components. Key Responsibilities Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms. Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes. Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams. Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution. Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations. System-Level Analysis & Integration Support Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows. Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations. Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance. Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups. Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions. Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles. Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops. Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team. Support for Senior L4 Initiatives Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements. Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions. Support the development of troubleshooting tools, diagnostic frameworks, and automation scripts. Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field. 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles. Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems. Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms. Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis. Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging. Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly. Preferred Skills: Experience with HVAC systems and building controls. Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins. Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers). Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows. Experience working in global, multiregional support environments. Performance Objectives: Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs. Improve product reliability by contributing RCAs, reproducible defect scenarios, and engineering-quality test cases. Reduce repeat escalations through robust analysis and knowledge sharing. Strengthen team capabilities through mentorship, documentation, and diagnostic tool improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and system stability. jobDescription: Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. Position Title: Deputy Manager – R&D (MV – ESE) Work Location: Ahmednagar Educational Qualification & Exp: B.E/ B.Tech (Mechanical/ Electrical) with 3 - 7 yrs of experience. Key Deliverables: 1) Design and development of medium voltage switchgears. 2) Providing technical expertise in product performance, and reliability. 3) Conducting Type tests as per IEC for MV products at third part labs like CPRI,ERDA,CESI., indepth knowledge of IEC std. 4) Conducting inhouse verification & validation for medium voltage equipment 5) Collaborating with cross-functional teams to successful completion of V&V activities. 6) Follow V&V program to ensure new package/product release to production within timeline. Functional Competencies: Develop and Implement V&V Plans: Create detailed verification and validation plans, including test strategies, test cases, and acceptance criteria, based on product requirements and specifications for MV switchgear up to 36kV. Routine Tests: Dielectric tests, resistance measurements, mechanical operation tests, etc. Functional Tests: Operational performance, interlocking mechanisms, protection system functionality, etc. Environmental Tests: Temperature cycling, humidity tests, vibration tests (as applicable). Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including design engineers, production engineers, quality assurance, and sales/marketing, to ensure product quality and customer satisfaction. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for improving V&V processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. The role requires deep expertise in SCADA systems, software troubleshooting, industrial communication protocols, and field support. The candidate will work closely with customers, system integrators, project teams, and product engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance and successful project execution. Key Responsibilities SCADA Software Support & Troubleshooting Provide L1/L2 technical support for SmartComm SCADA applications deployed across multiple customer sites. Diagnose and resolve complex software issues related to graphics, alarms, trends, dashboards, reports, databases, historian, and application performance. Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Support software upgrades, patches, migrations, and system enhancements. Industrial Communication & Device Integration Configure, troubleshoot, and validate communication between SCADA systems and field devices. Support integration with PLCs, RTUs, gateways, meters, VFDs, protection relays, and third-party systems. Work with industrial communication protocols such as: Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA/DA, BACnet IP/MSTP, IEC 61850, MQTT, SNMP, DNP3 Integrator & Customer Enablement Act as the technical focal point for System Integrators (ISPs) and implementation partners. Guide integrators during engineering, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. Conduct technical training sessions on SmartComm architecture, configuration, deployment, and best practices. Review project architectures and provide recommendations for optimal system performance and scalability. Remote & Onsite Support Provide remote diagnostics and troubleshooting support for deployed projects. Travel to customer sites for commissioning support, issue resolution, performance optimization, and customer acceptance activities. Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and system handover activities. Coordinate with customers to ensure timely resolution of critical issues. Technical Documentation Prepare and maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, support reports, and installation procedures. Document recurring issues and contribute to product improvement initiatives. Create technical notes and configuration documents for internal teams and partners. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Work closely with Product Development, Project Management, QA, and Engineering teams to resolve product issues. Provide feedback on product enhancements based on field experiences. Support new feature validation and beta testing activities. Required Skills & Experience Strong hands-on experience in SCADA/HMI software support, configuration, and commissioning. Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills for diagnosing software and communication issues. Sound understanding of industrial automation systems, PLCs, gateways, and field instrumentation. Knowledge of Windows Server, networking, databases (SQL), and cybersecurity fundamentals. Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, communication networks, and technical specifications. Strong communication and customer-handling skills. Willingness to travel extensively to project sites across locations. Preferred Qualifications Experience with SmartComm SCADA, AVEVA Plant SCADA, WinCC, FactoryTalk, Ignition, or similar SCADA platforms. Exposure to cloud-based monitoring solutions, IoT platforms, and historian systems. Success Factors Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to handle critical customer issues. Ability to work independently in field environments and under time-sensitive conditions. Passion for customer success, technical excellence, and continuous learning. jobDescription: MISSION The primary objective of this role is to carry out the design engineering for the development of Low Voltage (LV) Circuit Breakers / Switches and associated accessories. The role focuses on delivering innovative, cost-effective, and standards-compliant (IEC..) solutions tailored to customer-specific technical and market requirements. Lead the end-to-end product development process including design, prototyping, testing, documentation, and manufacturing readiness. Apply hands-on expertise in LV products such as MCCBs / ACBs / switches as well as accessories. Improve thermal performance, electrical life, short circuit performance of product. Use good understanding of current density, contact buttons, venting, and arcing for product improvement. Improve based on observations & graphs generated during testing. Conduct detailed engineering analysis using design fundamentals and tools (e.g., material strength, tolerance stack-up, mechanism design). Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, sourcing, finance, marketing, and suppliers to ensure design validation and production readiness. Define & carry out product qualification as well as validation testing. Support certification testing as per IEC testing (IEC 60947) using knowledge of standard, test procedure & acceptance criteria. Root cause analysis in case of failure. Maintain and update comprehensive product documentation including drawings, BOMs, and design guidelines. title: Associate Central Investigator
jobDescription: Mission The Associate Central Investigator plays a critical role in ensuring thorough and effective investigations of Trust Line alerts, mainly those classified as medium to high in severity and complexity. These alerts pertain to potential business misconduct, including bribery and corruption, fraudulent reporting, asset misappropriation, and conflicts of interest. The mission involves combating such fraud by investigating allegations raised by whistleblowers or by identifying anomalies through Artificial Intelligence. All investigations are conducted in alignment with the Trust Charter and in strict compliance with applicable laws and local regulations. Organization structure The position reports to the territory Central Investigator, part of the Fraud Examinations team in the Ethics and Compliance organization. This role works in cooperation with the regional compliance officer (RCO), HR managers, other central investigators and regional legal counsels. Main responsibilities Conduct business misconduct investigation while ensuring compliance with local laws, in close collaboration with territory Central Investigator and Regional Compliance Officers. Contribute to the predication (confirmed concern/allegation) with the regional compliance officer’s team Perform all required actions throughout the investigation process by collecting evidences and elements of information from open sources, by analyzing transactions and data in our information systems (ERP, CRM, CPQ, CONCUR, COUPA, etc…), by conducting interviews with witnesses, subject matter experts and suspects, by writing investigation reports including root cause analysis (and potential remediations/actions) and by presenting investigation outcomes to management (when required). Get a respectful behaviour with the reporter/whistleblower as a source of understanding and communication and keep anonymous level when is required by him/her. The main role of an investigator is to collect pieces of evidence as to confirm or refute allegations sent by whistle-blowers or anomalies detected by Artificial intelligence Contribute to anomalies detection activity by the development of anti-fraud algorithms based on artificial intelligence. Collaborate with local management to close the loop on alerts identified through anomalies detection algorithms. Personal competencies Strong capacity to assess critical situation with neutrality, objectivity and without bias. Proven ability to manage sensitive and complex situations in a matrix organization. Demonstrates a high level of confidentiality, integrity, and ethical judgment. Excellent collaboration skills and ability to build and maintain effective working relations across functions and geographies. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and professionally. Problem solving with analytic mindset including fact and systemic rationale. Data analytics skills (excel/pivot tables, Tableau) and basic knowledge of SAP transaction codes and table. title: DGM Direct Procurement Sourcing Management
jobDescription: INTRODUCTION: The Busway business is one of the fast-growing product lines within Low Voltage Power Products, manufacturing sheet-metal fabricated busway enclosures, housings, joints and copper/aluminium bus-bar assemblies for power distribution. This position is a Strategic Sourcing Buyer for the Busway category who will also act as the Procurement Manager, owning end-to-end procurement for the plant – sheet metal, fabrication, bus-bar/conductor materials, hardware, insulation and packaging. The role requires deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing (clean-sheet / should-cost), press-shop and fabrication processes (laser cutting, CNC punching/bending, welding, powder coating), and sourcing from vendors in switchgear, busway, panel-building or similar sheet-metal-intensive industries. The incumbent will design and implement the annual procurement operating plan for the plant, driving cost, quality, delivery and localization targets while managing the local supplier base end-to-end. RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. CATEGORY BUYER / PROCUREMENT MANAGER: Spend Management: Own the full procurement spend of the plant for sheet metal, fabricated parts, bus-bar/conductor material, hardware and consumables – supplier selection, development and Supplier Qualification (SAM). Manage supplier performance management, spend analytics, needs preparation and Annual Procurement & Purchasing Planning (APOP) for the Busway category. Coordinate effectively with Regional and Global Busway/sheet-metal category teams to formulate and execute category strategies at plant level. Own contract management and procurement risk management, including single/mono-source mitigation. Sheet Metal & Part / Component Development: Lead RFQ/RFP issuance, negotiations, PPAP/APQP coordination, pricing agreements and MSA/LTC/QTC coordination with fabrication and sheet-metal suppliers. Drive tooling and capex negotiations for press tools, dies and fixtures with fabrication vendors. Validate supplier quotes using clean-sheet costing / should-cost models for sheet metal (material yield, cycle time, press tonnage, tooling amortization, surface treatment/powder coating cost build-up). Cost Reduction / Productivity: Deliver annual cost reduction targets through negotiation preparation, should-cost analysis, external benchmarking, multi-year agreements, change of supplier, Value Engineering/Value Analysis (VAVE) and localization. Identify and implement design-for-sourcing and design-for-manufacturing opportunities in sheet metal parts jointly with Engineering. Plant Procurement Management & Supply Continuity: Act as the single point of contact for all plant-level procurement activities, ensuring uninterrupted material flow to the shop floor (line-side feeding, inventory norms, VMI where applicable). Collaborate with the plant Supply Chain team to ensure smooth material flow from suppliers and resolve day-to-day supply escalations. Drive alternate sourcing / change of supplier initiatives to secure supply continuity and avoid single-source or mono-source risk. Collaboration with Cross Functions: Partner closely with Plant Operations, Quality and Engineering to improve productivity, quality and on-time delivery for the Busway line. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES: Proven, hands-on experience in the Busway business or a closely related sheet-metal-intensive electrical/switchgear industry. Deep, practical understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet costing, press-shop processes, laser cutting, CNC bending, welding, fabrication and powder coating/surface finishing. Working knowledge of busway/switchgear components – enclosures, bus-bar assemblies (copper/aluminium), joints, insulation and their supplier base. Demonstrated experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning plant-level supply continuity, vendor management and cross-functional coordination. Strong negotiation, project management and cross-functional leadership skills in a matrix, multi-BU environment. Entrepreneurial, customer-focused, comfortable challenging status quo and driving change. Digitally savvy – keen to apply digital tools to improve procurement efficiency. Strong communication skills; fluent in English. REQUIREMENTS B.Tech / B.E. – Mechanical Engineering (Electrical background also considered) Minimum 10-15 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing / Procurement, with substantial exposure to the Busway business or a similar sheet-metal-fabrication-intensive industry (switchgear, panel building, enclosures, electrical equipment manufacturing). Deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet cost methodology, press shop economics, tooling investment, laser cutting, CNC bending/punching, welding and powder coating. Strong knowledge of buy analysis, should-cost/clean-sheet costing and BOM-level cost breakdowns for fabricated and bus-bar/conductor parts. Prior experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning end-to-end plant procurement, supplier management and supply continuity. Hands-on experience with rebalancing / localization of critical sheet metal and fabricated parts. Experience working in a matrix environment across organizations and functions. Strong leadership, negotiation and performance management skills. title: DFSR Practitioner
jobDescription: About the Role Design for Safety and Reliability Practitioner ensures that our Breaker products meet the highest standards of functional safety, reliability, and compliance. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in DfSR methodologies, functional safety standards and hands-on experience with Breaker & Motor Management. Key Responsibilities Apply Design for Safety and Reliability (DfSR) principles during product development to meet safety integrity and reliability targets. Conduct Functional Safety Analysis (FMEA, FMEDA, Fault Tree Analysis) and ensure compliance with IEC and ISO standards. Define and validate Safety Requirements Specifications (SRS) for motor management systems and solid-state devices. Collaborate with design teams to implement safety architectures and diagnostic coverage strategies. Perform reliability modeling and prediction using tools like ReliaSoft, Weibull++, or equivalent. Develop and execute safety validation and reliability test plans (HALT, HASS, burn-in, thermal, surge, vibration, etc.). Support certification processes with third-party agencies (e.g., TÜV, UL). Drive root cause analysis for safety or reliability-related failures and implement corrective actions. Maintain documentation for safety case development and compliance audits. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field. Functional Safety Certification (e.g., TÜV FS Engineer) and Six Sigma Green/Black Belt preferred. 5+ years of experience in safety and reliability engineering, preferably in motor control or industrial automation. Strong knowledge of IEC 61508, ISO 13849, IEC 60204, and related safety standards. Hands-on experience with Motor Management Relays, Solid-State Relays, Breakers related technologies. Proficiency in FMEA, FMEDA, Fault Tree Analysis, and reliability prediction tools. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills. jobDescription: DGM – Supplier Vigilance Auditor & Project Manager (India) Mission To strengthen Schneider Electric’s ESG risk‑mitigation across its global supply chain, this senior role leads Supplier Vigilance audits, drives regional audit planning, manages improvement projects, and contributes to broader Procurement Sustainability programs. As a critical member of the global Vigilance Plan, the role provides leadership, subject‑matter expertise, and digital transformation capability to elevate the maturity and impact of supplier ESG risk management. Responsibilities Lead On‑Site Supplier Vigilance Audits Execute the regional audit plan (approx. 35-40 on‑site audits/year) Conduct 2–3‑day audits following Responsible Business Alliance (RBA/EICC) methodology and Schneider’s Vigilance standards. Validate findings with suppliers and develop Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) to mitigate key risks across Labor, Ethics, EHS, and environmental domains. Follow up until CAP closure and report progress to regional Procurement leadership. Deliver supplier and internal stakeholder trainings related to EHS, Labor, Ethics, and Sustainability expectations. Methodology & Program Contribution Contribute to continuous improvement of global Vigilance Plan methodologies, tools, and processes. Support the definition and validation of new audit standards where needed Represent India in cross-regional alignment workshops, audit norm updates, and governance forums. Regional Audit Planning & Stakeholder Management Define the yearly regional audit plan with Procurement Directors and Category teams. Manage coordination with internal auditors, external 3rd‑party audit firms, and suppliers to ensure efficient deployment. Prepare audits through supplier profiling and risk analysis (sector, geography, past performance, labor intensity, etc.). Influence and engage cross‑functional teams (Procurement, Sustainability, Supplier Quality, Supply Chain) to support risk‑mitigation actions. Project Management & Continuous Improvement Lead projects to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of the Supplier Vigilance program. Drive improvements in audit logistics, workflows, reporting quality, supplier performance tracking, and risk segmentation models. Manage timelines, KPIs, cross-functional dependencies, and communication plans for regional or global initiatives. Digitalization, Data Analytics, AI & Automation Lead or support digital transformation initiatives to modernize the program, including: deployment of digital audit platforms or mobile audit tools improved dashboards (Power BI), analytics, and data‑driven risk‑targeting automation of recurring workflows exploration and piloting of AI use cases (e.g., automated document analysis, NLP‑based supplier risk flagging, intelligent sampling) Train regional teams on new tools and digital audit techniques. Support Broader Procurement Sustainability Programs Collaborate with global and regional teams to integrate audit insights and directly contribute to programs such as: Decent Work (living wage, working hours, forced labor, grievance systems) Supplier Decarbonization / Zero Carbon Project (verification of energy/carbon data during audits) Product Chemical Compliance (REACH/RoHS practices review during process audits) Sustainable Packaging & Green Materials Human Rights Due Diligence expansion beyond manufacturing Coaching & Capability Building Support part-time auditor upskilling programs and onsite audit shadowing for capability growth. Proven experience conducting on‑site industrial audits. Working knowledge of RBA/EICC, labor rights standards (ILO), local labor law, ethics & anti‑corruption controls, ISO 14001/45001 basics. Strong project management abilities: driving timelines, stakeholder alignment, KPI reporting. Skilled in digital tools: Power BI, advanced Excel, workflow tools; familiarity with AI/automation concepts. Strong analytical capabilities and ability to interpret complex audit evidence. Competencies High integrity and strong passion for Ethics, EHS, and Labor rights. Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder engagement skills across multiple levels.
